1.  **Rasterization:** Project all global surfels onto the target image plane [S1].

The evidence explicitly states in the 'Neural Surfel Association' and 'Rendering' sections that global surfels are projected onto the image plane. Specifically, it mentions: 'For each local neural surfel, project each global surfel as an ellipse onto the image plane' and 'Conduct differentiable rasterization on neural surfels to project them on the target image plane.' This directly supports the claim that global surfels are projected onto the target image plane.

Project these 2D pixel features to 3D surfel features $\mathbf{f}_t^{\mathtt{merge}}$ using an MLP [S1].
